title: Binance Margin: Gradual Rollout of Changes to Cross Margin Pro
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Margin recently announced  upcoming changes to Cross Margin Pro , which were originally scheduled to occur on  2025-01-21 10:00 (UTC) .  To better ensure the stability of the Cross Margin Pro service and the safety of users’ positions, Binance Margin will instead implement a  gradual rollout  of the following changes across users’ Cross Margin Pro accounts. Key Updates: Margin Requirements Initial and Maintenance Margin requirements will be adjusted for all Cross Margin Pro accounts on  2025-01-21 10:00 (UTC) , as originally scheduled.  Changes to Margin Level Calculations These changes will be rolled out across Cross Margin Pro accounts gradually over the following weeks.  Collateral Haircuts :   Collateral haircuts  will be applied when calculating collateral values as part of Margin Level calculations.  Open Order Loss : Due to collateral haircuts, the collateral value of assets to be bought in an open order may be less than the collateral value of assets to be sold in the same order. This loss in collateral value is recognized when the order is placed, which is factored into Margin Level calculations and maximum borrow or transfer amounts.  Please note:  The changes to Margin Level calculations and the impact of collateral haircuts may potentially increase the risk of liquidations. Users are advised to maintain sufficient assets as a buffer against potential changes to their Margin Levels. Please refer to  this FAQ  for more details. Users may find out more about the rollout progress of the upcoming changes to Cross Margin Pro in the banner section of the  Cross Margin trading page . The banner will contain details on when the aforementioned changes will occur, and which UIDs are affected.  The banner section in the trading page can be found as a pop-up at the bottom right corner on Web, and on top of users’ screens in the Binance App.  Guides & Related Materials: Introduction to Binance Cross Margin Pro   How to Activate the Cross Margin Pro Mode on Binance   How to Calculate the Margin Level on Cross Margin Pro   How to Calculate the Maximum Borrowable Amount on Cross Margin Pro   Binance Cross Margin Collateral Haircuts   Margin Service Terms of Use   Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-01-20
